message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: a health supervision official (administrative law enforcement) who, as a public official, failed to transfer criminal cases of illegal medical practice to judicial authorities, instead gave administrative penalties, allowing continued illegal practice, for personal/departmental economic benefit. This is abuse of power / dereliction of duty. The list includes "滥用职权" (abuse of power). Also possibly "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益"? Not exactly. The conduct is not about covering up proceeds, but failing to transfer. The appropriate charge is "滥用职权". Also maybe "受贿"? He got economic benefit? The text says to achieve economic tasks, personal economic benefit, but not explicit receipt of bribes. It says he didn't propose criminal prosecution to meet economic tasks, to achieve personal economic benefit. Could be considered "滥用职权" (abuse of authority). The list also includes "经济犯" but that's generic. The earlier examples: for misuse of authority they used "滥用职权". So answer: [罪名]滥用职权<eoa>.
